screen.alpgmc.class_select.title: Choose Your Class
screen.alpgmc.class_select.warning: This choice cannot be changed later.
message.alpgmc.level_up: Level up! You are now level %s
screen.alpgmc.stats.title: Stats
class.alpgmc.warrior.penalty: Natural food healing reduced by 90%. Cannot make potions.
class.alpgmc.warrior.bonus: Melee damage +40%, attack speed +20%, knockback resistance 50%, double output when crafting arrows.
class.alpgmc.archer.penalty: Cannot attack with weapons or tools, throw tridents, or craft arrows.
class.alpgmc.archer.bonus: Dedicated bow and arrows, bow damage +50%, 30% chance to save an arrow, move speed +15%, fall damage -50%.
class.alpgmc.mage.penalty: Can only wear Mage Robes. Cannot use smithing tables.
class.alpgmc.mage.bonus: Identifies gear and adds options at the Option Workbench.
class.alpgmc.healer.penalty: All attack damage reduced by 90%, except damage from summons.
class.alpgmc.healer.bonus: Makes potions at the Alchemy Workbench, Regeneration aura, double natural healing, two upgradable summoned wolves.
class.alpgmc.tank.penalty: Cannot craft wearable armor. Move and mount speed reduced by 30%.
class.alpgmc.tank.bonus: Max health +20, damage taken -30%, knockback immunity, cheaper repairs at the Enhancement Anvil, Taunt skill.
message.alpgmc.vanilla_replaced: This station is disabled. Use the mod workstations.
message.alpgmc.branch_unlocked: You can now choose a combat branch. Open the stat screen (K).
command.alpgmc.class.branch_wrong_class: That branch does not belong to this player's class
screen.alpgmc.branch.title: Combat Branch and Production Tree
branch.alpgmc.berserker.1: Damage rises as health falls (up to +50%%)
branch.alpgmc.berserker.4: Ultimate: ignore damage for 10s (3 min cooldown)
branch.alpgmc.dual_wield.1: Attack with the off-hand weapon too, alternating hands
branch.alpgmc.dual_wield.3: Hitting 3 or more enemies raises attack speed
branch.alpgmc.dual_wield.4: Ultimate: spin attack for 5s (continuous area damage)
branch.alpgmc.sniper.3: Crouching grants invisibility, removed on attack
branch.alpgmc.crossbow.2: One reload fires 3 shots in a row
branch.alpgmc.crossbow.4: Ultimate: rapid fire without reloading for 10s
branch.alpgmc.debuffer.2: Adds Slow and Weaken skills, debuff duration +50%%
branch.alpgmc.debuffer.4: Ultimate: area curse (greatly lowers defense and speed)
branch.alpgmc.summoner.1: 3 wolves with more health and damage
branch.alpgmc.summoner.2: Heal for the damage your summons deal
branch.alpgmc.guardian.2: Take 30%% of nearby allies' damage for them
branch.alpgmc.guardian.4: Ultimate: nearby allies take no damage for 5s
branch.alpgmc.gladiator.1: Reflect 50%% of damage blocked by a shield
branch.alpgmc.gladiator.2: Parry: blocking within 0.5s before a hit negates it and stuns the attacker
branch.alpgmc.gladiator.3: Axes can't disable your shield, a successful block adds +50%% to the next attack
production.alpgmc.warrior.1: Crafted custom weapons get a quality grade (common, fine, rare)
production.alpgmc.warrior.3: Better quality chance, crafted weapon durability +50%%
production.alpgmc.warrior.4: Ultimate: special ammo (piercing, explosive), top quality crafting
production.alpgmc.archer.4: Ultimate: extra rare custom material drops
production.alpgmc.mage.0: Identify: reveal options on unidentified gear (mage only)
production.alpgmc.mage.1: Add option: one random option in an empty slot (T3-T5)
production.alpgmc.mage.3: Lock: keep the other options while rerolling
production.alpgmc.mage.4: Ultimate: raise an option one tier (up to T1)
production.alpgmc.healer.0: Use the Alchemy Workbench, make basic custom potions (healer only)
production.alpgmc.healer.2: Combine two potion effects into one
production.alpgmc.healer.3: Add one side effect to a potion
production.alpgmc.healer.4: Ultimate: special potions (revive, temporarily lift class penalties)
production.alpgmc.tank.2: Better enhancement odds, failure no longer destroys gear
production.alpgmc.tank.3: Disassemble: recover materials based on option tiers
